message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules** | # | Rule | What it means | |---|------|---------------| | **1** | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house‑rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to play all your cards in each round. | | **2** | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. | | **3** | **Turn order** | Players take turns clockwise (or counterclockwise if a “reverse” card is played). | | **4** | **Playing a card** | On your turn you may play one card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top card on the discard pile. | | **5** | **Special cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes direction of play.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn (can only be played if you have no other playable card). | | **6** | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw from the draw pile until you can play or the pile is empty. | | **7** | **Uno** | When you have **one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before your turn ends. If another player catches you not saying it, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **8** | **Winning a round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points based on the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **9** | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. First to reach the target score wins the game. | | **10** | **House rules** | Many groups add variations (e.g., “Stacking” where Draw Two cards stack, “Seven-O” where 7 lets you swap hands, etc.). Clarify before starting. | **Quick Play Summary** 1. Deal 7 cards each. 2. Flip top card to start discard pile. 3. Clockwise play: match color or number, or play a special card. 4. If you can’t play, draw until you can. 5. Say “UNO!” when you’re down to one card. 6. Finish the round when someone discards all cards. 7. Score and continue until someone reaches the target. Enjoy your game!
